name: Abhinav Capital Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Abhinav Capital Services Ltd is in the business of giving Corporate Loans & Investment activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ACSL is a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking Non Banking Financial Company. Its business is to grant and obtain loans and advances and invest surplus funds in shares and securities. It has a tie-up with a Market research team which advises them about various Investment options.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.11 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.78% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 10.0% over last 3 years.
